specimen.purpose: The one gold Elvish figure word that opens each page.

tengwar.purpose: Alcarin Tengwar line inked beneath the figure word.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared with the app; hover lifts, note rules, arrow nudges.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: letter-spacing 0.06em to normal, 1.2s ease, second word delayed 0.12s

components.name: Press Action
components.description: The one enamel action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-press { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0 1.3rem; border-radius: 3px 16px 3px 16px; background: #8fcf96; color: #10251a; text-decoration: none; font: 600 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-press:hover { background: #a6dcab; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-press:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fcf96; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: Secondary door, outlined in Cloak Line.
components.css: .ds-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0 1.15rem; border-radius: 3px 16px 3px 16px; border: 1px solid #56655a; color: #e6ece3; text-decoration: none; font: 600 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: #98a896; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fcf96; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead Nav
components.description: Plain text links on Deep Ground; current page underlined in enamel.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; background: #222a25; padding: 1.2rem 1rem; } .ds-nav a { color: #bccab9; text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.97rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; padding-block: 0.4rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #e6ece3; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: #e6ece3; border-bottom-color: #8fcf96; }

components.name: Figure Word
components.description: Gold Elvish specimen with footnote numerals, Tengwar line and pronunciation.
components.html:
Pedo1 Edhellen2

Say it: PEH-doh eh-THEL-len
components.css: .ds-fig { background: #2b352f; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-spec { margin: 0; font: 400 4.5rem/1 Marcellus, Georgia, serif; color: #dcb862; } .ds-spec sup a { font: 600 0.9rem Figtree, sans-serif; color: #b8995a; text-decoration: none; padding: 0 0.1em; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-spec sup a:hover { background: #dcb862; color: #222a25; } .ds-say { margin: 0.35rem 0 0; color: #98a896; font: 500 0.97rem Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-say b { color: #bccab9; }

components.name: Margin Note
components.description: Numbered note with hairline above; lights gold when its call is active.
components.html: 1. pedo speak! Tolkien's command at the door of Moria.
components.css: .ds-notes { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 1.25rem; border-left: 1px solid #46544a; counter-reset: note; font: 400 0.9rem/1.55 Figtree, sans-serif; color: #bccab9; background: #2b352f; } .ds-notes li { position: relative; padding-top: 0.6rem; } .ds-notes li::before { counter-increment: note; content: counter(note); position: absolute; top: -0.15rem; left: 0; font: 600 0.8rem/1 Figtree, sans-serif; color: #b8995a; } .ds-notes li::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.1rem; right: 0; top: 0.18rem; height: 1px; background: #46544a; } .ds-elv { display: block; font: 400 1.25rem/1.2 Marcellus, Georgia, serif; color: #dcb862; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: Screenshot plate: 6px radius, line border, the system's only shadow.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; background: #2b352f; padding: 1rem; } .ds-img { height: 120px; background: #35413a; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #56655a; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

narrative.overview: The site is the Lorien cloak set as a scholarly page. It shares the visual family of the Pedo Edhellen app (src/styles.css) and the Lam Edhellen translator: a twilight green ground with a fine diagonal weave, silver text, gold for Elvish, enamel green only for things you press. What is new here is the apparatus. A reading column sits beside a ruled margin of numbered notes, and each page opens with one Elvish word at display scale as its figure, its words carrying superscript citation numerals that answer in the margin.
keyCharacteristics: One reading measure (64ch) plus a 17.5rem ruled margin of notes, in a two-column leaf.
Gold is Elvish (and its footnote numerals); silver is everything read; enamel green is only what you press.
A figure word in Marcellus gold, with Tengwar inked beneath and a pronunciation line, opens each page.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px rules; the only shadow is under screenshot plates.
Tokens inherited from the app: colors, font stack, --leaf-r and --ease; the site adds --measure, --margin, --gap, gold-dim and gold-hover.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Gold means Elvish, enamel means press, silver means read. A color never takes a second job.

rules.name: The Press Is One Rule
rules.body: Each screen has one enamel press action; the other doors are quiet outlined.

rules.name: The Figure Word Rule
rules.body: Every page opens with one Elvish word or name in gold specimen type, its Tengwar beneath in Silver 2, and how to say it.

rules.name: The Cited Word Rule
rules.body: An Elvish word that needs a source takes a superscript numeral; its note sits in the margin beside it.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline in Soft Line; do not enclose in a filled or shadowed container.

dos: Do open each page with one gold Elvish figure word, its Tengwar and a pronunciation line.
Do put sources in the margin of notes and link them with superscript numerals.
Do keep one enamel press per screen and draw other actions as quiet.
Do separate with 1px Soft Line rules and keep text to the 64ch measure.
Do keep Marcellus for Elvish and headings, Figtree for reading, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use cards, icon tiles, glows or filled containers for grouping; use the leaf, the rule and the list.
Don't spend gold on anything that is not Elvish, a citation or a link, or enamel on anything not pressable.
Don't add shadows beyond the plate.
Don't restyle the shared tokens here; change them in the app and carry them across.
